name: WCON Electronics Co., Ltd.
summary: WCON Electronics Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacturing, and sale of connectors and cables for industrial control, automotive electronics, new energy photovoltaic and energy storage, data center, and consumer electronics sectors in China. The company offers electronic connectors, intelligent electronic products, metal stamping and metal die-casting molds, plastic molds, plastic products, and automation equipment. It also provides IDC and FPC, discrete wire, I/O, automotive cables, and solar photovoltaics cables.
